retrievalProfile.description: A 1990s country-western aesthetic featuring full-body portraits of musicians against a stark white background with bold, textured typography and western graphic motifs.

recipe.visualDefinition: Two male figures in western attire—one in a black suit with a guitar, the other in a red and black flame-patterned shirt and cowboy hat—posed against a white void. The composition is anchored by a heavy black header block containing metallic, western-style lettering and a longhorn skull graphic.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast figures against a pure white background
Bold black header block balancing the verticality of the subjects
Repetition of flame and western motifs across clothing and borders
Right-aligned secondary text balanced by a decorative vertical border
coreInvariants: Metallic or engraved textures on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-length figures occupy the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled to nearly the full height of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large black rectangular block in the top right corner containing the primary title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subjects' faces on the left, across the guitar neck to the primary logo, then down to the secondary title and vertical border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the figures and separating the text elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and Yellow (flame patterns and border details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast black and white with highly saturated primary accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed bold serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, blocky serifs with internal engraving details
Secondary text uses a condensed, high-contrast serif with a drop shadow
Integration of illustrative elements (longhorn) into the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O's and 'D's in the main title feature metallic, beveled textures resembling belt buckles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, textured slab serif for the brand name paired with a cleaner, condensed serif for the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic western feel for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of two men in western attire (one in a black suit with a sunburst electric guitar, one in a red/black flame shirt and cowboy hat) standing against a pure white background. Leave the top right and far right edge clear for graphics.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black rectangular block in the top right. Inside it, place large metallic-textured slab-serif text. To the right, add a vertical border of yellow and red triangles. Place the subtitle in condensed red serif font with a drop shadow in the remaining white space.

verificationChecks: Does the primary text have a metallic, engraved texture?
Is the flame pattern present on the clothing?
Is there a vertical geometric border on the right edge?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar neck does not intersect awkwardly with the text.
Verify the metallic texture on the text looks like embossed metal.
Check that the flame pattern on the shirt is vibrant and clear.
Confirm the white background is completely clean without shadows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Western Portrait + White Void + Black Header Block + Metallic Slab Serif + Flame Accents
